candidate.definition_en: Plain or obvious; clearly seen or understood.
candidate.explanation_ar: واضح جداً وظاهر للكل، ومش محتاج تفكير كتير عشان تفهمه.

senses.definition_en: Plain or obvious; clearly seen or understood.

examples: It became evident that he was lost.
Her talent was evident from a young age.
The success of the policy is evident in the statistics.
candidate.mnemonic: جاية من 'Evidence' 'دليل'.. لما الدليل يكون موجود، الحقيقة بتبقى 'Evident' 'واضحة'.
